rationales: A prepared solution is planned rather than reached without proper planning.
A candid solution is the intended choice for a solution not reached through proper algorithmic or work planning.
A strategic solution is based on planning and strategy.
A best solution is selected after evaluating possible solutions.
Start marks the beginning, not the termination point.
Set is not the usual termination point of an algorithm.
Goto transfers control to another point rather than terminating the algorithm.
Stop marks the termination point of an algorithm.
A Boolean proposition is simply a statement that can be true or false, not the specific classification intended here.
“It is old maid” is treated as a categorical proposition that attributes a quality to a subject.
A moral proposition expresses a moral judgment, which this statement does not.
This statement fits the categorical-proposition option.

The
tag inserts a line break.
<hi> is not a standard HTML line-break tag.
<u> underlines text rather than inserting a line break.
<hr> inserts a horizontal rule, not a line break.
Problem understanding is not limited to one W-question.
The standard set contains more than three W-questions.
Five Ws are used to understand a problem.
Eight is not the standard number of Ws used for problem understanding.
A connector links separated parts of a flowchart.
The arrow is a flow line showing the direction of control.
Direction describes what the arrow indicates, not the name of the symbol.
Start is a flowchart terminal, not an arrow.
10010₂ equals 18, not 15.

A·B + A·C is not generally equivalent to the given expression.
A·(B·C) is not generally equivalent to the given expression.
A + (B + C) is not generally equivalent to the given expression.
By the Boolean identity (A+B)(A+C)=A+BC, this is the equivalent expression.
E-mail does not stand for electrical mail.
Electronic medium is not the expansion of e-mail.
E-mail stands for electronic mail.
Electronic message is not the standard expansion of e-mail.
Seven layers belong to the OSI model, not the traditional TCP/IP model.
Three is not the standard number of TCP/IP layers in this curriculum.
The traditional TCP/IP model has four layers.
Five is not the standard layer count used for the TCP/IP model here.
Cyber crime is crime involving computers or networks.
Software is not the type of crime referred to here.
Program is not the type of crime referred to here.
Computer crime is a broader phrase, but the intended term in the option set is cyber crime.

The terminal symbol is used to mark the start or end of a flowchart.
A connector joins flowchart sections rather than marking start or end.
A process symbol represents an operation or instruction.
A decision symbol represents a condition or branching point.
A truth table evaluates logical expressions, not the sequence of an algorithm’s execution.
A trace table tracks variable values and steps to help check an algorithm for logical errors.
A simple table is not the standard tool for tracing an algorithm.
A flow table is not the standard name for this checking tool.
B represents 11 in hexadecimal, not 12.
C represents 12 in hexadecimal.
D represents 13 in hexadecimal.
